history_summary.value: The Penedesenca comes from the Penedes region of Catalonia, where dark-egg-laying farm chickens were traditionally kept, with efforts to save the type from extinction beginning in 1928. The black variety was standardised in 1946 as the Villafranquina Negra, and the breed nearly died out again before being revived by dedicated breeders in the 1980s.
